evidence.quote: The SetUnhandledExceptionFilter function returns the address of the previous exception filter established with the function. A NULL return value means that there is no current top-level exception handler.

open_questions: The rows cover setting the filter; Windows calling it on an unhandled exception is exception dispatch (roadmap Sprint 047).
